data.exact_reserve_text: The syndicate has refined its approach this year end in establishing the technical provisions for claims outstanding reserves and reinsurer's share thereof held as compared to the end of the previous year. Included within net calendar year claims incurred of $14,529,000 is an improvement of $12,197,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end.

prior_year_events.event_name: 2018 natural catastrophe events (US and Japan) - industry mention
prior_year_events.impact_description: Industry deterioration reported for 2018 natural catastrophe events in US and Japan, but the syndicate's gross loss estimates remained fairly stable or reduced, indicating a prudent approach to loss estimation.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a prior-year release: an explicit net improvement of $12.197m in claims reserves established at the prior year end. The managing agent also states they refined their reserving approach at year-end which contributed to the movement. The opening gross claims outstanding (2018 comparative) was $67.730m. The movement represents an approximate 18% favorable adjustment on that opening balance. The syndicate primarily writes property treaty reinsurance and the movement is presented as a net release in the accounts.
raw_causal_phrases: The syndicate has refined its approach this year end in establishing the technical provisions for claims outstanding reserves and reinsurer's share thereof held as compared to the end of the previous year.
Included within net calendar year claims incurred of $14,529,000 is an improvement of $12,197,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end.
data.data_quality_notes: No gross prior-year movement (gross PYD) figure was presented. The note explicitly states a net improvement of $12,197k which has been used as a fallback (NET of reinsurance). Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the balance sheet (2018 comparative). All amounts are reported in the report's native currency (USD). Claims development triangle is present but only contains 2018 and 2019 columns so it does not permit calculation of multi-year prior-year development for years <=2017.
